title: The Disappearing Trophy
incident: The solid-silver 'Founders Cup' disappeared from its locked mahogany plinth between the team banquet at 9:00 PM and the morning awards ceremony at 8:00 AM. A celebratory group photo taken at 9:45 PM reveals an unexpected detail in the background reflection.
centralQuestions: What does the glass reflection in the 9:45 PM photo reveal?
Who had access to the plinth key in the head coach's office?
How was the heavy trophy transported past the front gate?

timeline.event: Team banquet concludes; trophy placed in center showcase.
Head Coach Arthur Miller locks the display case with brass key.
Team captain and players take selfie photograph in front of glass case.
Equipment Manager Toby Ross loads team laundry bags into maintenance van.
Showcase opened for awards; plinth holds a weighted replica sandbag.

suspects.name: Arthur Miller
suspects.motive: Fired effective end of season; resentful of club board leadership.
suspects.statement: He says he locked the case and went straight home at 9:20 PM.
relevant_evidence: Held only physical key to case.
His car logged leaving gate at 9:22 PM.
supporting_evidence: Gate camera records his departure at 9:22 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Spare key was missing from his desk drawer in the morning.
suspects.uncertainty: Departure at 9:22 PM makes physical theft at 10:00 PM impossible unless he returned on foot.
open_questions: Did he give the key to someone?

suspects.name: Toby Ross
suspects.motive: Struggling with pay garnishment; collects silver bullion.
suspects.statement: He states he was packing jerseys and loading the laundry van all evening.
relevant_evidence: Van left gate at 10:30 PM carrying oversized canvas laundry bags.
suspicious_evidence: One laundry bag was weighed down heavily on the van suspension.
suspects.uncertainty: Wet football jerseys and pads weigh over 70 pounds.
open_questions: Was the trophy inside one of the laundry hampers?

suspects.name: Julian Thorne
suspects.motive: Anger over trophy being awarded to school rather than individual MVP.
suspects.statement: He says he left with his teammates after taking the selfie at 9:45 PM.
relevant_evidence: Keys to gym equipment shed in his pocket.
supporting_evidence: Seen at diner with 4 teammates at 10:15 PM.
suspicious_evidence: His gym bag was found hidden in the shower stall.
suspects.uncertainty: Diner alibi at 10:15 PM corroborated by waitstaff.
open_questions: What is visible in the reflection of his 9:45 PM photo?

witnesses.name: Club President Sterling
witnesses.statement: The trophy weighs 28 pounds—it cannot be pocketed; it requires two hands or a bag.
witnesses.limitations: Was at banquet until 9:00 PM only.

evidence.title: Instagram Photo (9:45 PM)
evidence.description: High-resolution selfie photo. In the glass reflection behind the team, a figure in a green equipment staff jacket is visible opening the rear access latch.
evidence.establishes: The case was being breached during the photo at 9:45 PM by someone in staff attire.

evidence.title: Canvas Bag Fibers
evidence.description: Heavy green canvas fibers snagged on showcase lock pin matching club laundry bags.
evidence.establishes: A green club equipment bag was used to cushion or open the lock.

evidence.title: Security Gate Weight Telemetry
evidence.description: Automatic tire sensor at front gate logged Toby's laundry van at 320 lbs over empty curb weight at 10:30 PM.

evidence.title: Team Photo Shadow Anomaly
evidence.description: High-resolution victory photograph taken at 4:30 PM shows the trophy cabinet reflection displaying an unlatched padlock.
evidence.establishes: The display lock was disengaged 45 minutes earlier than staff reported.

evidence.title: Equipment Bag Weight Discrepancy
evidence.description: Logistics scale registered duffel bag #4 as 14.2 kg departing the locker room instead of the standard 6.5 kg jersey weight.
evidence.establishes: A heavy metallic object was transported inside duffel bag #4.
evidence.does_not_establish: The exact contents of the bag.

redHerrings: Coach Miller's missing spare key was actually found dropped behind the file cabinet, not stolen.
Julian Thorne's hidden gym bag contained only muddy cleats from the game.

hiddenSolution.explanation: Toby took advantage of the team's loud group selfie session at 9:45 PM to unlock the rear plinth using the master maintenance tool, substituted a weighted sandbag from the gym shed, slipped the silver cup into an equipment laundry bag, and drove it past the security gate at 10:30 PM.
decisiveEvidence: E-A (Reflection in 9:45 PM photo showing green staff jacket)
uncertainties: Whether the trophy has already been melted or hidden at Toby's home
hiddenSolution.alternativeExplanation: Julian Thorne took the trophy before the photo and Toby was merely inspecting the display case.

missingEvidence: Search of Toby Ross's off-campus apartment
Gate camera zoom on passenger seat
rules: Photographic reflections often capture evidence invisible to human observers at the time.
Circumstantial weight evidence must be corroborated with physical trace fibers.
